name: The Isle of four Winds: Rune War
summary: The Isle of the Four Winds: Rune War combines traditional Asian Mahjong with strategic territorial conquest in a fantasy world. Players alternate between five-minute Mahjong rounds and tactical Rune War phases. During Mahjong sessions, players compete against up to three opponents to form tile combinations that unlock magical spells, summon creatures, and provide strategic advantages. These earned benefits transfer to the Rune War phase, where players deploy them to capture territories on a fantasy map. Performance in the tile-matching segments directly determines available resources and abilities during territorial battles, creating an interconnected gameplay loop between puzzle-solving and strategic warfare.
